notes:
- Add Double Zigzag and adjustable slanted Zigzag underlay for open Satin, with controls for spacing, stitch length, angle and margins.
- Use same-side Zigzag spacing for new closed Satin and Tatami fills. Existing projects retain their settings and can opt in from Underlay.
- Keep the cover sequence and pinned entry and exit when using the new Zigzag spacing. Shorten the sewn connection into the cover on supported Edge Run plus Zigzag fills.
